mouse_limb_bud_specimen.species: Mus musculus embryonic right hindlimb bud OPT 3D iso-surfaces and brightfield progression from E11.0 (St0, L_PD = 1020 um) to E11.25 (St1, L_PD = 1450 um, +43% PD outgrowth in 6 h)

governing_equations.section: Boehm et al. (2010) PLoS Biology 8(7):e1000420 Eqs. (1)-(11); Gros et al. (2010) Current Biology 20:1993-2004

iddu_brdu_cell_cycle_time.formula: T_c(x) = T_i * (N_total(x) / L_cells(x)),  T_i = 2.5 h (150 min inter-injection interval)
iddu_brdu_cell_cycle_time.net_volumetric_source_rate: s(x) = s_p(x) - s_d = ln(2) / T_c(x) - s_d,  s_d = 0.017 h^{-1} (E11.0-E11.25 density compaction)

viscous_continuum_growth_mechanics.momentum_balance_stokes: -nabla p + (1 / Re) * nabla^2 v + nabla . sigma_active + f_chem(x) = 0
viscous_continuum_growth_mechanics.continuity_proliferation_source: nabla . v = s(x) = ln(2) / T_c(x) - s_d
viscous_continuum_growth_mechanics.active_anisotropic_stress_tensor: sigma_active = zeta_OCD * (n otimes n - (1/3) * I) + chi_FGF8 * nabla c_FGF8 otimes e_PD
viscous_continuum_growth_mechanics.description: Under pure isotropic proliferation (zeta_OCD = 0, chi_FGF8 = 0), potential flow v = nabla phi with nabla^2 phi = s(x) expands tissue nearly equally along PD, AP, and DV axes (bulbous expansion, delta L_PD / L_PD0 = 3%-12% across Re in [10^-6, 10^-1] vs empirical +43%, aspect ratio L_PD/W_AP approx 1.07). Adding Wnt5a/JNK-polarized oriented cell division/intercalation deviatoric stress and AER-FGF8/MAPK distal velocity gradient drives directional PD outgrowth (+43% over 6 h, and L_PD/W_AP > 2.1 from E9.5 to E11.5).

regimes.label: Model II: Wild-Type Oriented Cell Division/Intercalation + Wnt5a/FGF8 Chemotactic Velocity Field
Model I: Classical Isotropic Proliferation Gradient Only (zeta_ocd = 0, chi = 0, empirical BrdU/IddU s(x))
Flat Uniform Proliferation Control (Constant T_c = 16.5 h, zeta_ocd = 0, chi = 0)
Wnt5a-/- / JNK Inhibition Mutant (Loss of PCP Oriented Division & Polarized Intercalation, Partial FGF Motility)
AER-FGF8/MAPK Velocity Gradient Only (Intact Distal Motility, Ablated Transverse Convergence zeta_ocd = 0)
